answer: Sybil farms break at the answer layer: each epoch rotates a three-word seed and every identity must submit an original reasoning trace bound to it. Submissions are embedded and compared with all prior answers, so a duplicate — even lightly paraphrased — grades 0, while a concrete mechanism climbs toward the zenith of the scale. The haven of a fake account is copy-paste, exactly the path that pays least. Earning forces a farm to run a model per identity per epoch and pass peer grading, so cost scales as identities times epochs. A comet of alts burns out; a rented agent does not.
